about: Journal search ignores accents and case in every language (localization plan, UX 2026-11-05): "cafe" finds "café", "animo" finds "ánimo". The server is the rule: search_entries (migration 014) compares extensions.unaccent(lower(normalize(x, NFC))) of the query and of the body, still a plain substring (%, _ and \ literal). The clients only mirror it for the bold match in a result's snippet and for their fakes: fold each character on its own (lower-case, then the table below, then drop the combining marks U+0300–U+036F), keep a map from folded to original positions, find the folded query in the folded body, and bold the original characters. Umlauts fold to the base letter (ü → u), never to "ue": "muede" does not find "müde". Letters outside Latin are unchanged (Thai matches as typed). unaccent also maps rare symbols the table leaves out (ligatures, ½); then a client may fail to place the match and shows the snippet without bold, never a wrong bold. Every case below must hold on the server (supabase/tests/search_fold.sql), in the app and on the web.
